info.name: Integration Reliability Sandbox
info.description:
Requests for the Integration Reliability Sandbox API, in learning order. Select the "Integration Reliability Sandbox" environment and set base_url first.

Delivery is asynchronous. The "Poll ..." requests wait poll_interval_ms before each send and, in the Collection Runner, repeat themselves until the work is done. When sending by hand, click Send again on a Poll request until its test says it finished.

Scripts store tokens and IDs as CURRENT values in your environment. Do not share an environment export after running, and never paste tokens into shared places. Full guide: docs/postman-walkthrough.md. API reference: /docs/ on the server.

exec: // Fail early with a clear message if no environment (or no base_url) is selected.
if (!base) throw new Error('base_url is empty. Select the "Integration Reliability Sandbox" environment (top right) and set base_url.');
if (base.endsWith('/')) throw new Error('base_url must not end with "/". Example: http://localhost:3000');
// Helps match this request with the server log line.

item.name: 2. Create an anonymous session
item.description: Creates a demo session and stores its token in the secret environment variable session_token. The token is shown once, expires after 24 hours, and is not a user account. Never paste it into shared places.

exec: pm.test('token looks like a demo token', () => pm.expect(body.token).to.match(/^irs_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/));
